## Reconciliation note (outside the CSV)

Brandon and I replayed all 600 positions in the workbook's Replay order sheet. This comparison keeps one row for each of the 90 TRUE flags in that order. The key and arrival are identical in the two runs. All datetimes carry the replay date and use PST.

Start each date empty at 09:00. For each review, take the later of its arrival and the preceding completion in that condition. In the lunch condition, move a candidate start in [12:00, 13:00) to 13:00. In each condition completion is three minutes after start and wait in minutes is start minus arrival.

Check the three blocks for 28, 32 and 30 rows. QD-287 and QD-327 bracket the December 5 lunch arrivals. The last completions on December 4, 5 and 6 are at 16:06, 15:30 and 15:42 in both runs, leaving no reviews open at 17:00.
